thread.title: Einhorn adds to Brighthouse Financial stake, trims Apple, GM holdings - MarketWatch

author: MarketWatch
title: Einhorn adds to Brighthouse Financial stake, trims Apple, GM holdings - MarketWatch
text: Hedge-fund manager David Einhorn's Greenlight Capital added to its stake in Brighthouse Financial BHF, -0.78% during the first quarter, according to a regulatory filing on Tuesday. Greenlight added 40,000 shares of the life insurance and annuities company that was spun out of MetLife last year, bringing its total stake to 11.04 million shares as of March 31, according to filing tracker Whalewisdom.com. Brighthouse was Greenlight's second-largest holding. Greenlight trimmed its stake in General Motors Co. GM, +0.85% which remains its largest holding, by 3.2478 million shares, leaving it with more than 22.6 million shares. Greenlight also sold more than 1.56 million shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.91% during the quarter, leaving it with a stake of 628,100 shares, its 11th largest holding. Large investors must disclose long stock positions held at the end of a quarter 45 days later in a 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
